boulders.name: Area 2 (Cream Cheese)
boulders.approach: Walk past the Messiah boulder for a few hundred feet and you will see a low cave. This is the Little Woman cave and from here you approach all other problems.

boulders.name: Cliff Area
boulders.approach: This is the first area you approach as you are walking down the trail.

boulders.name: Anticipation Boulder
boulders.approach: Directly left of the Sunkist Boulder.

boulders.name: Chalked Hold Boulder
boulders.approach: Instead of going straight through the clearing, make a right and follow a trail for about a minute. You will see the boulder.

boulders.name: Folded Rock
boulders.approach: Go straight from the clearing and look left.

boulders.name: The Pearl a.k.a. The Whale boulder
path: The Pearl a.k.a. The Whale boulder
boulders.approach: Scramble up past 1996 boulder to a rock perched on a few other rocks. You can't miss the prow that forms the Pearl.

boulders.name: Platform Boulder
boulders.approach: Slightly uphill and to the right of the Out of the Ashes boulder

boulders.name: Sunkist Boulder
boulders.approach: Go straight through the clearing. The big boulder behind the first boulder you see.

boulders.name: Khadejha Area
boulders.approach: Exit lower parking lot from the left; walk past information kiosk on your right, follow carriage road with fence on right, bear right and go up slight incline (this is the Bunkbed Wall). Continue past the Bunkbed Wall…

boulders.name: Cloud 9 Area
boulders.approach: Continue past the Rock Garden area for a few minutes along the base of the cliff until you pass through a very obvious tunnel. The problems are above and below that tunnel, and there are a few inside it as well on the…

boulders.name: Diving Board Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot, walk past the Outbreak boulder area (The Quarantine) and continue on yellow/blue marked trail. Walk past the talus fields without actually scrambling on any rock yet - keep right. Pass the nothing…

boulders.name: Golden Wall Area
boulders.approach: Follow the directions to the Golden Wall . Directly uphill from the Quarantine/Outbreak area.

boulders.name: Goldfish Boulder and Hector Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk past the quarantine area along the yellow/blue trail. When you see the Atrium boulders, shortly before the SPF boulder, turn left. Goldfish boulder should be apparent on the right after a short distance. Hector…

boulders.name: Khadejha Area
boulders.approach: From the guidebook: From the gate house, walk into the open meadow, then walk toward the cliff. Walk along the blue trail that runs the base of the cliff. After two minutes, you will arrive in an area with a large roof…

boulders.name: Quarantine Area & Outbreak Boulder
boulders.approach: From the east end of the parking lot, follow gravel path through an open field. Eventually you'll reach a clearing where you can see the cliff line. From here head right. The trail will split, but it doesn't matter…

boulders.name: SPF Boulder
boulders.approach: From the parking lot, walk past the Outbreak boulder area (The Quarantine) and continue on yellow/blue marked trail. Walk past the talus fields without actually scrambling on any rock yet - keep right. Pass the nothing…

boulders.name: Tiger Style Boulder
boulders.approach: Go past the Quarantine Boulders. After 2 minutes, move up through the talus towards a massive roof. The Tiger Style boulder sits next to the Diving Board boulder.

boulders.name: Andrew Area
boulders.approach: Walk down the Carriage Road until you see the obvious roof (you'll also likely find hordes of people milling around it).

boulders.name: Boxcar Area
boulders.approach: The Boxcar boulder is easily spotted as you walk down the Undercliff Road. From the Trapps bridge, walk north on the Undercliff road for 20 or 25 minutes. When you are getting close, you will pass the Andrew boulder…

boulders.name: Doug's Roof
boulders.approach: Four minutes north on the Undercliff Road, look for the big roof that abuts the road on the left-hand side.

boulders.name: Herman Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk past (to the right) of the Boxcar Boulder, and uphill. You can't miss it.

boulders.name: Hot Springs Hotel
boulders.approach: In between jaboo and sleepy hollow. Past boxcar boulder

boulders.name: Jahboo Area
boulders.approach: Walk past Boxcar further down the road for about 2 minutes and you will see a horizontal roof not far from the road. This is located before the Sleepy Hollow Area.

boulders.name: Kama Sutra Area
boulders.approach: A little bit past the Pebbles Boulders as you walk north up the Undercliff Road. If you reach the East Trapps Connector trail (AKA the Stairmaster) you've gone to far. The problems are on the cliff and boulders near and…

boulders.name: Keyhole Cliff area
boulders.approach: Walk three minutes north on the Undercliff Road from the Trapps Bridge.

boulders.name: Nameless Area
boulders.approach: The Nameless boulder is right against Undercliff Road. From the Trapps bridge, walk north on the Undercliff road for 20 or 25 minutes. When you are getting close, you will pass the Andrew boulder which overhangs the…

boulders.name: Pebbles Boulders
boulders.approach: Walk 5 minutes north on the Undercliff Road from the Trapps Bridge past the toilet in the Uberfall area.

boulders.name: Sleepy Hollow
boulders.approach: Five minutes after leaving the Boxcar Area, the carriage road makes a right turn. Turn left, and go directly up the hill.

boulders.name: Stairmaster
boulders.approach: Best approached by parking at the Gunks visitor center and walking around .25 miles up the stone staircase at the end of the upper lot. There are many boulders here, so definitely more to be explored. This area may…

boulders.name: Steel Bridge Boulders
boulders.approach: The Steel Bridge boulders are located on the northern side of the Trapps Bridge, which crosses above route 44/55 not far from the West Trapps parking area.

boulders.name: Suzie A Boulders
boulders.approach: Five minutes north on the Undercliff road and a little bit past Doug's Roof and the Uberfall Problems you will find the Suzie A boulder near the Uberfall outhouse and kiosk.

boulders.name: Terrace Area
boulders.approach: The easiest way to find the problems is to walk east about 30 feet. On the north side of the trail, you will see a set of stairs that go to a small cliff band. These stairs will bring you to all of the problems. If you…

boulders.name: Trapps Cabin
boulders.approach: From the west Trapps lot cross the steel bridge and start up the carriage road. Take the trail on your left that leads up to the boulders. If you've reached the blue-blazed Millbrook Ridge trail, you've gone too far.

boulders.name: Uberfall problems
boulders.approach: Four minutes north on the Undercliff road, a hundred yards past Doug's Roof you will find the Uberfall problems. If you get to the Uberfall outhouse you've gone too far.

boulders.name: Venus in Scorpio Boulder
boulders.approach: Past Nameless area but before Boxcar area, this boulder is uphill, closer to the cliff than the road. It is visible from the road.

boulders.name: Lower Wawarsing Boulder
boulders.approach: The boulder is located on the East Trapps Connector trail between the northern Visitors Center parking lot and the Wawarsing Parking lot. It's pretty hard to miss as it abuts the trail. The boulder has a wire attached…

boulders.name: Warwarsing Boulder
boulders.approach: The Warwarsing boulder is located near the entrance to the Wawarsing parking lot between the lot and Route 44/55. See the parent area for a more detailed description of the approach.

boulders.name: West Zone
boulders.approach: From the dried up stream, walk about 50 feet down the trail and then go right, following a small cliff band. Most of the boulders in this area are located on this first cliff band, or on the boulders that surround it.
